bagPolicy.summary: Mercedes-Benz Stadium allows clear bags made of plastic, vinyl, or PVC up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small non-clear bags up to 4.5” x 6.5”. All other bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small non-clear bags up to 4.5” x 6.5”
prohibited: Bags that do not meet the specified guidelines
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available in the Red Deck and Silver Deck of the Georgia World Congress Center, subject to availability. MARTA offers a convenient and affordable option at $2.50 each way, with stops near the stadium.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Mercedes-Benz Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Mercedes-Benz Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including vegetarian and gluten-avoiding choices. Highlights include a Vegan Smokehouse Sausage and Quinoa Bowl. Beverage options range from sodas to premium draft beers.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Mercedes-Benz Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Mercedes-Benz Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
